newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 9.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The budget for the Ivory Coast capital Abidjan in 1997 will be 20 billion CFA. Of the money, 84 percent will be devoted to day to day running of the city, while 15 percent will be set aside for investment.

- The National Telecommunications Council has ruled that Publicom, a private telephone company, can use structures already put in place by recently privatised Ci-Telecom. The ruling ends a dispute between the two companies over the use of public telephone booths.
- Minister of Education Pierre Kipre says teachers' demands for higher salaries cannot be met because there is no money.
